lines: Manish Sharma, a Promoter Selling Shareholder, may receive up to ₹6.08 crore if all offered shares are sold; this sale is up to 45,000 shares.
Proceeds have been in hand since 11 Mar 2026, 248 days ago, so this trigger is not fresh; the sale itself is the reason for the call.
Retained value is an estimate of ₹110.73 crore at the offer price; average cost of acquisition is unknown, so gain cannot be assessed.
Family link: Priyanka Manish Sharma shares the name Manish Sharma, which may be worth noting in the conversation.
